_README: EXAMPLE ONLY. The real file lives in YOUR DATA OVERLAY, never in the engine
repo: <data-root>/config/exec-registry.json (normally
../.heading-os-data/config/). It is classified `private` in
config/routing-map.yaml and must stay that way: it carries real names,
titles and work email addresses.
WHAT IT IS: your ORGANISATION'S CHART. It answers exactly one question:
who is an executive in the business. Hand-maintained; no tool writes it.
You only need this file if you track an executive team. A single-operator
install can skip it; the loader returns an empty chart and that is fine.
ITS SIBLING: <data-root>/admin/executives.json is a DIFFERENT file
answering a DIFFERENT question: who is provisioned as a HEADING OS user.
See scripts/executives.example.json.
DO NOT put install facts here. Whether someone uses HEADING OS, what their
data repo is called, how far their provisioning got: all of that lives in
the roster. A copy kept here goes stale and then lies. That is not
hypothetical: this file once carried an `aios: removed` flag meaning 'not a
HEADING OS user', and by the time anyone read it again the two people it
named had been active users for two months.
Stable IDENTIFIERS may appear in both files. `name` and `github_user` do
not drift, and an executive with no roster row still needs a handle. Only
LIFECYCLE facts are kept apart.
Join the two with scripts.utils.workspace.load_fleet(), which returns one
record per person with explicit is_business_exec / is_heading_os_user flags
and renames the two same-named `status` fields apart.

_schema.slug: kebab-case identifier. The join key with admin/executives.json.
_schema.name: Full name.
_schema.title: Job title as the business uses it.
_schema.role: Short business-role token (admin, cso, cfo, coo, exec, ...). `admin` marks the operator and is excluded from fleet aggregation.
_schema.platform: windows | darwin | linux. Which OS they work on.
_schema.status: EMPLOYMENT status: active | departed. Not provisioning status.
_schema.provisioned: Date they joined the workspace ecosystem, YYYY-MM-DD. Historical record only.
_schema.github_user: Optional. Stable identifier, safe to duplicate from the roster.

executives.name: Chris NoInstall
executives.title: Chief Operating Officer
executives._note: A real executive who does not use HEADING OS. No row in admin/executives.json, and that absence IS the record. Do not add a flag here saying so.
